evidence.quote: The query result location that Athena uses is determined by a combination of workgroup settings and client-side settings.
When this option is enabled, the workgroup settings take precedence over the applicable client-side settings when an IAM principal associated with that workgroup runs the query.
Each workgroup configuration has an Override client-side settings option that can be enabled.

claim: The query result location that Athena uses is determined by a combination of workgroup settings and client-side settings. Each workgroup configuration has an Override client-side settings option; when it is enabled, the workgroup settings take precedence over the applicable client-side settings when an IAM principal associated with that workgroup runs the query.
